caption: The drawing features three distinct elements: a full-length, long-sleeved dress, a detailed close-up of the dress’s sleeve and bodice, and a faint sketch of the back view of the same dress. The main dress, positioned front and center, is rendered in shades of gray and black, suggesting folds and shadows in the fabric, and it has a fitted bodice with a row of closely set buttons down the front, a high collar, and a gathered, flared skirt. To the upper left of the main dress, there is a close-up drawing of the inside of the dress’s bodice, displayed in tan and cream tones with dark lines to represent seams and stitching, and a sleeve rendered in dark gray. In the upper right, an unfinished, lightly sketched outline in gray pencil depicts the back view of the dress, showing lines for the collar, sleeves, waist, and skirt without any detailed coloring. The background of the drawing is plain, off-white paper, and the artist’s name, “Lillian Gansz,” appears in the lower right area.
title: Quaker Dress
